name: Leaf
content:
# Welcome to MicroPatterns!
# Display is 200x200

# Define patterns using DEFINE PATTERN
DEFINE PATTERN NAME="dither" WIDTH=8 HEIGHT=8 DATA="1011111111110101010000111100001111000110101110111111111110110111"

VAR $rotation
LET $rotation=13+ $second%7

# Draw a line using FILL_PIXEL
# It will only draw where the background 'checker' pattern is 1
COLOR NAME=BLACK
FILL NAME="dither" 

VAR $diag_pos

REPEAT COUNT=200 TIMES
    LET $diag_pos = $INDEX
    translate DX=$diag_pos DY=$diag_pos
        
    REPEAT COUNT=400 TIMES
       ROTATE DEGREES=$rotation
       TRANSLATE DX=0 DY=1
       FILL_PIXEL X=$diag_pos Y=$diag_pos
    ENDREPEAT
   
     RESET_TRANSFORMS
ENDREPEAT
